name: 8-model two-stage ensemble checkpoints (r7v1/r7v2/r7v3/r5v2 x baseline/redesign)
detail: 'redesign' and 'split' are the same arm, used interchangeably across different scripts/logs (confirmed via ensemble_run.log's own '=== bucket_redesign (split): ... ===' summary lines). Architecture: separate stage1 (has-stance-vs-other) and stage2 (hostile-vs-endorsement) HF sequence-classification checkpoints per tag/arm, matching infer_round9_twostage.py's loading pattern and the round9pool CSVs' s1_p_other/s1_p_hasstance/s2_p_hostile/s2_p_endorsement columns. Locations found 2026-08-20: r7v1 baseline+redesign ONLY on conspiracycomments-gce:stance-twostage-retrain-asb (~/retrain_twostage/r7v1_{baseline,redesign}_stage{1,2}, 1.5GB each = 6GB total). r7v2 baseline+redesign, r7v3 baseline+redesign, r5v2 baseline+redesign all on gpuincrease:vm2image-20260810-093317 (paths: ~/retrain_twostage/r7v2_{baseline,redesign}_stage{1,2}; ~/outputs/round8/checkpoints_twostage/r7v3_retrain/{baseline,redesign}/stage{1,2} -- r7v3_retrain is the better checkpoint per earlier session notes, not plain r7v3/; ~/outputs/round8/checkpoints_twostage/r5v2/{baseline,redesign}/stage{1,2}). A SEPARATE, different-architecture flat single-3-way-classifier set (num_labels=3, one model per tag/arm, no stage1/stage2 split) also exists on gpuincrease:vm2image at ~/outputs/round8/checkpoints/{tag}_{arm}/ for 5/8 combos -- this is NOT the same thing as the two-stage set and does not match the round9pool CSV column structure; don't confuse the two when looking for 'the ensemble checkpoints'.

name: ensemble+binconf_other015 70/30 blend (kappa 0.428)
detail: FOUND 2026-08-20 -- Nash pasted the original computation from a parallel/earlier session (not saved as a script anywhere, was ad-hoc inline analysis). Exact method: old_p_hasstance = 1 - val680_ensemble_combined.csv['p_other'], new_p_hasstance = preds_binconf_other015_binary_confidence.csv['self_confidence'], combined = w*old + (1-w)*new at w=0.7 (raw probability blend, NOT log-odds), then SWEPT threshold 0.1-0.95 and took the best kappa (not fixed at 0.5) -- this threshold-sweep is why an earlier fixed-threshold-0.5 reconstruction attempt landed on a different apparent-best weight (0.6) and a slightly different kappa. Verified exact reproduction: threshold=0.55, stage1 kappa=0.4280. Overall 3-way kappa at this exact config (stage2 = binconf's own polarity pred among gated-stanced rows): 0.5656.
